name: print-social-andre-martinez-designer-poster-purple-orange-cutout-shapes
title: 'Andre Martinez, Graphic Designer' poster in purple with orange cut-out shapes and a pointing hand icon
whatItMeans: Bold and personal; cut-out hands and shapes turn a personal portfolio poster into a piece of graphic art itself.
whatItIs: A purple A4 poster with a large bold condensed name 'ANDRE MARTINEZ' and pink 'GRAPHIC DESIGNER' pill, a lime 'HIRE ME' tag with a pointing hand, a photo of the designer reviewing a print in a mustard blazer bordered in white, a services list in a lime rounded box, and cut-out pink and lime hand and leaf shapes.
techniques: Use cut-out hand shapes as playful pointing devices.
Border a portrait photo in white for a sticker-like pop.
Name the person as the headline for direct personal branding.

vocabulary.definition: A thick white outline making a photo look cut out and applied.
A graphic element like a hand or arrow directing attention.
